status: Prepared for Founder review; not approved for manufacture

products.name: The Utkal T-shirt
products.proposal: Relaxed crew neck; 100% combed cotton; 220 GSM; sizes S-XXL. These are quote targets, not selected stock.
products.placement: Centre front, top of print 80 mm below the front neck seam on the proposed M sample. Confirm size grading and print clearance. Back blank.
products.process: Ask for a soft-hand screen-print sample and a short-run transfer alternative. Vendor to specify ivory underbase, registration and care.
products.confirm: Blank SKU, composition/GSM evidence, size chart, shrinkage, wash/rub result, actual print box and unit costs.
products.sample: One M sample proposed, plus fabric and colour swatches. Founder to confirm size and spend.

products.name: The Jhula Bag
products.proposal: Cotton canvas, 300 GSM; body 380 x 420 mm; 80 mm gusset; handles 650 mm total length. Proposed quote targets.
products.placement: Centre front on the body. Top of print 60 mm below top hem; 50 mm side margins at the proposed body width. Reverse blank.
products.process: Two-colour screen-print proposal, sea blue and laterite. Ask for clean small gaps and a physical colour proof.
products.confirm: Body/handle dimensions, fabric weight, handle attachment, seam finish, load-test method/result, print area and unit costs.
products.sample: One decorated sample proposed, with actual body/handle measurements and load-test evidence.

products.name: The Story Cup
products.proposal: 330 ml ceramic mug; straight-sided blank preferred for the story wrap. Supplier confirms actual capacity and dimensions.
products.placement: 200 x 85 mm preliminary wrap: emblem panel x=10-85 mm, story panel x=110-190 mm. Leave the handle exclusion zone to the actual vendor template.
products.process: Ask for a ceramic transfer/decal proposal compatible with the chosen two-tone blank. No dishwasher/microwave claim without supporting evidence.
products.confirm: Capacity, diameter/height, full printable template, handle clearance, glaze/decoration process, colour swatches and supported care/contact-use documentation.
products.sample: One decorated sample proposed showing both emblem and readable story. Check actual-size lettering and handle alignment.

products.name: The Utkal Water Bottle
products.proposal: 750 ml, single-wall stainless steel, proposed grade 304; screw cap with replaceable seal. No insulation claim. Supplier confirms suitability.
products.placement: 70 x 150 mm front-only print; centre on body, above base shoulder. Lower wave band stays within the front panel in this version; no unapproved wrap.
products.process: Ask for a multi-colour screen/transfer method compatible with the coating. Confirm smallest gaps, colour registration and abrasion durability.
products.confirm: Material grade evidence, usable capacity, body/neck dimensions, coating, cap/seal, leak-test result, print box, care and unit costs.
products.sample: One decorated sample proposed. Inspect lid, seal, leak performance, finish and print alignment.
